prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a crisp high fidelity SDM local-network web control panel design board, flat front-on UI screenshots, no device mockup/perspective/photography. Large 3840x2160 landscape canvas, perfectly legible English interface text, consistent desktop application design, generous room and complete uncut screens. Match existing SDM Android aesthetic: background #070707, charcoal surfaces #111214 and #17181A, thin #2D2D29 borders, gold #D4AF37 and #E8C65A accents, off-white #F4F2E9 text, muted #96958E, green #78C7A5 status, muted red #D98181 destructive actions, rounded 16px cards and 22px dialogs, plain thin outline icons and bold compact clean sans-serif typography. Never use blue/purple gradients or generic Material cards. Desktop shell: left narrow sidebar gold outlined SD monogram and 'SDM', entries Downloads, Files, Settings; device connection indicator bottom 'Xiaomi 11T Pro · Connected'. Main top bar status 'Downloads run on your phone', device chip, search, gold '+ Add download'. LAN-only address example http://192.168.1.42:8080. File paths mean phone folders, no cloud/computer storage and no monthly subscription. Show usable precise controls and real plausible static values. No Basic Auth, no username/password, no YouTube, no automatic media detection, no Always keep active. Shared same app shell, tokens, icon language and spacing across every screen. Each screenshot board should have a small numbered title outside its UI, only minimal captions. BOARD 01 — Connection and downloads. Two equally large complete desktop screenshots side by side, each with enough readable detail. Left screen 01 'Connect to your phone': no sidebar yet, centered SDM identity, text 'Control SDM over your local network', 'Approve this browser on your phone', device Xiaomi 11T Pro, displayed short pairing code '482 916', gold 'Request access', secondary 'Use pairing code', subtle security 'Only approved browsers can control this phone'; compact inset phone approval sheet 'Web panel access', browser 'Chrome on Mac', '192.168.1.18', two buttons Decline / Allow, no credentials. Right screen 02 'Downloads': full desktop shell with sidebar Downloads active, dark compact statistics row '3 active', '8.4 MB/s', '2.1 GB remaining', '32 connections'; tabs All 18 / Queue 10 / Completed 8; table with selectable rows, file icon/name, status/progress, speed, size, ETA, active connections, gold miniature pause or resume and overflow. Fictional files Ubuntu-24.04.iso downloading 42% 6.2 MB/s 16 connections; Blender-assets.zip downloading 68% 740 KB/s 8 connections; Nature-film.mkv paused 21% 0 KB/s; torrent Open-movies-pack seeding 100% 4 peers. Gold thin progress bars. Bottom inline nonmodal selected-rows toolbar '2 selected' Pause Resume Priority Remove. One restrained active queue reorder handle. No chart taking over entire dashboard. Make the table desktop dense yet spacious and professionally aligned.
